abstract: Murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells fail to express viral T antigen following infection with polyoma (Py) virus, while some differentiated derivatives are fully susceptible to viral infection. The block to expression in EC cells apparently occurs after adsorption and penetration but prior to the synthesis of early viral proteins. The F9 EC cell line was employed to further investigate the failure of Py gene expression in EC cells as well as the viral susceptibility of certain differentiated cell types. F9 cultures treated with retinoic acid (RA) or RA in combination with dibutyryl cAMP (dBcAMP) are quantitatively induced to differentiate to endodermal cell types. When the fate of the viral DNA was examined in F9 EC cells, free viral DNA was observed early after infection but was eventually lost with continued cell growth. Cultures induced to differentiate in the presence of RA demonstrated limited viral susceptibility which increased with prolonged RA exposure. Polyoma sensitivity did not directly parallel basement membrane antigen production, a marker used to distinguish this differentiated endodermal cell type. Viral gene expression could be obtained if Py DNA was introduced into the cells prior to RA induction. In contrast, the endodermal progeny derived from a dual treatment with RA plus dBcAMP appeared highly refractory to Py infection.
abstract_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞はポリオーマウイルス感染後にT抗原を発現しないが、一部の分化した誘導細胞はウイルスに感受性を示す。F9胎児性癌細胞は、胎児性癌細胞におけるPy遺伝子発現の欠如と、特定の分化細胞の感受性について調べるために用いられた。胎児性癌細胞でウイルスDNAの運命を調べたところ、感染後早期には遊離ウイルスDNAが観察されたが、細胞増殖が続くとやがて消失した。レチノイン酸存在下で分化誘導された培養細胞は限られた感受性を示し、その感受性はレチノイン酸への暴露期間が長いほど増加した。ポリオーマ感受性は基底膜抗原産生とは直接一致せず、これは内胚葉様分化細胞の指標として用いられるマーカーである。Py DNAを誘導前に導入するとウイルス遺伝子発現が得られた。一方、レチノイン酸とジブチリル環状AMP(dBcAMP)の併用処理による内胚葉子孫細胞は、Py感染に対して著しく抵抗性であった。
